message:
The other day, we had a storm warning, and I found myself digging out the old board games from the back of the closet. You know, the ones that have been gathering dust since the kids were little? I thought, why not have a little family fun while we wait out the weather? 

We spent hours laughing and arguing over Monopoly, and I even let the grandkids win a few rounds. Who knew a little low-tech entertainment could bring us all together like that? 

So, if a storm's brewing, maybe consider stashing away the screens and rediscovering some of those classic games or puzzles you loved. What’s your favorite way to keep things light and fun during a storm? ☔
